newsitem.title: UKRAINE: Ukraine Jan inflation 2.2 pct vs 0.9 pct in Dec.
newsitem.headline: Ukraine Jan inflation 2.2 pct vs 0.9 pct in Dec.

text.p: Ukraine's monthly inflation rate accelerated to 2.2 percent in January from 0.9 percent in December 1996, the Statistics Ministry said on Tuesday.
UKRAINE CONSUMER PRICES JAN 97 DEC 96 JAN 96
Deputy Prime Minister Viktor Pynzenyk had forecast January inflation up between three and four percent because of higher consumer spending during the holiday period.
The 1997 draft budget foresees annual inflation of 25 percent against 39.7 percent in 1996 and 181.7 percent in 1995.
